name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> form: domain=spell, descriptor=handler_id_4_via_full_screen_flash. The '4'/'id_4' is the spell ID (valid 00h-23h domain ID, registered at dispatch table 0x51D01 entry index 4 per xref 0x51D11=0x51D01+0x10) and MUST be preserved, not an address residue (self addr 0x21396 has no '4' suffix relation). 'full_screen_flash' matches the worker fd2_execute_offensive_full_screen_flash_spell @ 0x213B7 and distinguishes this animation variant from the blink-overlay family (id 0-3,8). Name accurately reflects purpose and internal logic.
purpose: Spell dispatch thunk for spell_id=4: forwards the cast to the full-screen-flash offensive spell worker.
logic_summary: Watcom stack-probe preamble __CHK(0x14), then tail-calls fd2_execute_offensive_full_screen_flash_spell(caster, 4, n_tgt, tgt_arr) with the spell_id literal 4 hardcoded. No branching (cyclomatic complexity 1). In the original binary this is the shared-tail anchor for sibling thunks id 5/6/7, which JMP into its tail at 0x213AA after pushing their own spell_id; the Layer-2 rebuild emits each handler as a separate equivalent C function (functional equivalence, not byte-exact codegen).

params.name: caster
params.semantics: Caster unit id; passed straight through to the worker as arg 0.
params.reason: Clear, no address residue, and consistent with the entire spell.c handler family. Ghidra's longer alias 'caster_unit_id' is not needed; 'caster' is unambiguous in context.

params.name: n_tgt
params.semantics: Number of targets; forwarded to the worker as the num_targets arg.
params.reason: Concise and accurate; consistent across all sibling handlers in spell.c. No address residue.

params.name: tgt_arr
params.semantics: Pointer to the target unit-id array (byte[]); cast to int and forwarded to the worker.
params.reason: Accurately names the target id array; consistent with the family. No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; pure dispatch forwarder.
